focused_command is a plan-specified future-gate tool test command; its target file scripts/ranking-v3-contract-seal.test.mjs does not exist at round_base, so it is unverifiable-at-base. affected_command pnpm test:scripts is repo-verified (package.json line 26).

The four kinds are fixed: feature, training, decision, activation (ContractIndexEntryV1). The seal never contains or hashes a future seal; ContractSealV1 binds planSha256, qualificationTargetSha256, contractIndexSha256, taskGraphSha256, baselineCommit, baselineTreeSha256, sealedAt - no self-referential digest is permitted.
